name: Reverse
source:
Takuma died in a traffic accident when he was young, but his spirit continued to live in his fraternal twin sister Takumi and gained ability to read other peoples hearts. Using that ability they help people in school to solve their problems.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
牧原拓马年幼时死于交通事故，灵魂却继续寄宿在异卵双胞胎妹妹牧原卓美体内，并获得了读取他人内心的能力。兄妹二人运用这项能力，帮助学校里的人解决烦恼。

[根据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]
